JUST IN: Shopify reveals Grok Bot and other agents are playing a "real role" this shopping season, and calls it the first agentic Black Friday

Harley Finkelstein (President): "The reason I mention that is those are very specific products. And I think one of the new things that's happening in 2026 is this is the first real Black Friday where agentic is playing a real role. [Agentic meaning] Muse or Instinct or Grok Bot. These agents reward specificity."

"So what you're seeing is that consumers are not just saying, I want to buy a phone for my kids. I want to buy a screenless phone for my kids so I can call them when I'm traveling for work, like I do for Shopify. And instead of showing Best Buy, what's coming up is the Tin Can phone, who's already reported a 4x increase in sales from agentic sourcing."
